messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Without thyroid hormone, your body cannot function properly. This may result in poor growth, slow speech, lack of energy, excessive tiredness, constipation, weight gain, hair loss, dry, thick skin, increased sensitivity to cold, joint and muscle pain, heavy or irregular menstrual periods, and depression. When taken correctly, levothyroxine reverses these symptoms, although it may take several weeks before you notice a difference.
Levothyroxine is usually taken for life.
What levothyroxine is not used for:
Levothyroxine is not used to shrink benign (noncancerous) thyroid nodules or a nontoxic diffuse goiter in people who get enough iodine in their diet. It does not help in these situations, and taking more thyroid hormone than your body needs can cause an overactive thyroid. It is also not used to treat hypothyroidism during the recovery phase of subacute thyroiditis (inflammation of the thyroid gland).
Levothyroxine is not used to treat obesity or for weight loss.
Triplet: ["levothyroxine", "not used for", "weight loss"]

The relation 'not used for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is not indicated or recommended for treating the specified medical condition or purpose.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
B. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'should not be taken': The subject drug should not be taken in the form or combination specified by the object entity.
D. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
